name: Derrick
profile:
Born with a genetic gift that makes his body forever like that of a teenager, and never grow older physically, or die of old age, \N[1] is a 391 year old man from the forest village of
Klungleton.  His genetic quirk also gives him superhuman strength, speed, and agility, and makes him constantly regrow any lost and damaged body parts, without scarring, giving him perfect pure
white skin and more.  People with his DNA condition also don't require sleep, and are always awake and well-rested, and immune to magical sleep, charm, and mental attacks.  He is coincidentally
magically gifted, something which has nothing to do with his genetic gift.  His genetic condition is rare, and found in boys and men who usually come from different families that aren't related to
each other.  In only very rare cases do any females have this condition.  Boys and men who have it typically have the same facial features and in some cases, but not all, similar personalities,
despite usually coming from different families.  On the other people who have it often have relatives in their immediate family who have it, and are twins of each other.  Some who have it don't
mentally develop past teenage adolescence, effectively being eternal teenagers who don't age any further, while others mature into adulthood mentally while having their bodies not physically age
beyond that of a teenager, typically looking like a sixteen-year-old while actually being much older and grown up.  \N[1] and his younger brother \N[2] fought evil monsters that threatened
their home village of Klungleton over a hundred years ago, and after much battle they were rewarded by their national government, the Acrydian imperial government, with recognition and a large
fortune that they keep in their personal treasure room, enough to last them throughout their current retirement, for at least a hundred years more.

name: Jack
profile:
Born with the same genetic gift as Derrick, Jack is Derrick's younger brother by less than a year, who doesn't have his strength and speed enhanced quite as much as Derrick from his DNA fluke, as
the genetic quirk doesn't affect all people who have it the same way.  However it does give Jack the same face and pure white skin as his brother, as well as similar healing, no need to sleep, etc.

name: Ron
profile:
A former high school and college athlete, Ron is a skilled hunter and woodsman who is very physical, brawny, and tough, while not being as good at magical arts as most other people by nature.  He is
a longtime friend of Derrick and Jack, and also a resident of Klungleton.  He makes up for lacking aptitude for magic with excellent physical health and endurance, making him a good warrior.

name: Mike
profile:
A close buddy of Derrick and Jack, Mike is also a resident of the village of Klungleton and is very well-rounded, not being especially weak or strong in any ability or side to his nature.  Among
other things, he is a farmer who knows how to fend for himself in the wilderness.  When it comes to fighting, he is very average in that he isn't stronger or weaker than most at anything.

name: Ben
profile:
A fellow villager to Derrick and Jack, Ben isn't very physical or athletic, but is very bright and intellectually gifted in that he finds magic more natural and intuitive than most.  While not as
physically strong as his friends, he can still take care of himself in the forest near his home village of Klungleton.  Benjamin is also a fast learner, and levels up quicker than most.

name: Chris
profile:
A fellow villager from Klungleton, and a longtime companion of Derrick and Jack, Christopher grew up initially training to be a monk, which he later dropped out of to be a farmer, woodsman, and
fisherman, among things.  He has extreme mental focus and discipline with his mind and body, although he is something of a slow learner, making him level up slowly, despite having good endurance.

name: Billy
profile:
Billy is born with the same DNA gift as
Derrick, but isn't related to Derrick or
Jack.  Anyways, William has the same DNA
and therefore the same face as Derrick,
and the same special abilities that are
common of the genetic quirk.  Billy is a
young farmer in his early 20s and a ninja
by profession.  He often acts like a
teenager, including talking in teen slang
and so on, complementing his mohawk
haircut.  The genetic gift varies among
people who have it, and in Billy's case
it caps his mental maturity to that of a
sixteen year old teenager, though a
healthy one.  He has already accepted and
actually enjoys being a fun-loving
teenager for life, mental and physical,
never growing any older than such and
never facing death from old age.  He
finds it suits himself just fine.

name: Joe
profile:
Joe is born with the same genetic gift as
Derrick, yet isn't related.  Thanks to
the same DNA condition, Joe has the same
face as Derrick, and the same special
abilities as well, although specifics
will vary among those with the condition,
and Joe is no exception.  Joe is a
farmer and a combat mage, and magically
gifted more than most people are.  He is
young and bright, very smart.
